## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what a user or contributor can do after this change.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish fixture tests, source inspection,
native UI checks and live integrations. State any checks that remain unverified.

## Related work

Link related issues or pull requests. For an AI-assisted change, an optional session ID
may be included with the owner's consent. Never paste private conversations, credentials,
customer evidence or personal machine paths.
